rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or effect of making something larger or stronger.

example.english: The amplification effect of this speaker is quite noticeable.
example.traditional: 呢個喇叭嘅放大作用幾明顯。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 laa3 baa1 ge3 fong3 daai6 zok3 jung6 gei2 ming4 hin2

rows.note: Use this for the amount of increase in an electrical quantity such as voltage, power, or current.

example.english: The voltage amplification of this amplifier is not enough, so the sound cannot come through fully.
example.traditional: 呢部擴音機嘅電壓增幅唔夠，聲音出唔晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 kwong3 jam1 gei1 ge3 din6 aat3 zang1 fuk1 m4 gau3 sing1 jam1 ceot1 m4 saai3
